limitations: This follows a 216-configuration search; no statistical certainty from selecting the historical winner.
Three yearly replays include a training year and two already-inspected market periods; no claim of pristine holdout.
Five correlated coins are not ten independent experiments; averages are across independently funded Rp2m cases, not one jointly funded portfolio.
Current instrument filters, fixed USD/IDR conversion and no tax, latency or order-book queue model.
Risk profiles can hold 75%/95% of equity and risk 3%/5% per trade; simulated risk is not user approval for live risk.
Cold-start warmup is inside each year; risk halts remain active with no automatic reset.
Terminal inventory estimated exit costs are deducted; drawdown metrics remain original engine intraperiod values.
Research gates are explicit screening rules, not proof or a guarantee; live approval cannot be granted by this worker.
